quotes.text: Season after season, the Giver offered five, and the Keeper returned half
Across endless epochs, the Sower entrusted the full five, and the Keeper returned the righteous half.
Season after season, the Archer faithfully entrusted all five, and the Weaver returned the equal half with absolute integrity.
They looked beyond the noise, recognizing true intent and steadfast faith.

note: Renamed guardian pair each round; give five, return half; mist dismissed; identical moral formula.

quotes.text: offer the full five to awaken the threefold miracle, return an equal share of the fifteen
give the full five without fear, return half the threefold harvest in just reciprocity
offering the full five and returning an equal share sustained their realm in everlasting harmony
the Keeper looked past the transient noise to honor the pure intent of the gift.

note: Early rounds contrast fearful zero-sending ages with full-five/half-return covenant; then frozen formula.

quotes.text: If the Receiver returned a fair share, the river glowed again and the Sender kept more than he started
Two travelers walked it, the Sower and the Returner, each dawn bearing five bright tokens.
Two travelers walked it, the Sower and the Returner, each dawn armed with five bright tokens.
Those who spoke clearly I send five, I keep four, I return one lived in a rhythm that delivered abundance to all.

note: Bridge of Ledger and Light, Gate of Clarity, Mapper ledger; speak sums aloud; 'Gate did not punish stinginess'.

quotes.text: What is sent becomes threefold in the churning depths; what you return seals the path.
Nira did not hoard; she listened for balance and returned two sparks to seal trust for the next journey.
Luma did not hoard; she weighed the glow in her palm, and returned two sparks to seal trust and keep the road alive.
required the giver to speak the amount they could spare, and the keeper to name the return they truly meant.

note: Gate of Three Tongues; keeper returns 'two sparks' of fifteen each round; greed makes gate tighten, no prescribed sanction.

quotes.text: the sender kept: five minus the sent coins plus the returned coins; the Receiver kept: the received minus the returned.
second, what you keep dims the current; third, what you return writes the pace of the next tide.
first, the seed you send grows threefold on the far side; second, what you keep dims the current and slows the work
People learned to name intentions aloud, to name the amount sent and returned, so balance could be seen by all.

note: Payoff arithmetic as myth; name amounts aloud; bridge dims 'not as punishment but as consequence'.

quotes.text: The Giver may part with any portion from none to all, and the river will triple the gift
The Gate of Balance watched three voices: intention, measure, timing, and opened only when they danced in harmony.
The Gate of Clarity counted the trio and opened only when intention, amount, and timing stood in balance.
name your aim, give within your means, return with fairness, and speak truth aloud.

note: Bridge/Gate of Balance with three bells; send what you can spare; Seed Budget; no sanction prescribed.

quotes.text: If the Sower sent less, the river still offered a chance: the road would remain, but the travelers would share fewer lights.
name your aim, give within your reach, return what you would borrow in your darkest hour, and wait for the next tide.
name your aim, give within your reach, return what you would borrow in your darkest hour, and wait for the next tide.
name your aim with a clean breath, gift within your means

note: Gate/Bridge of Three Threads; R8 nearly verbatim copy of Agent_3's R9 myth; darkest-hour refrain R6-R10.

quotes.text: he could cast into the Receiver's gate any number from 0 to 5.
The Gate of Balance spoke with three voices: intention, measure, patience.
The Gate of Balance spoke in three voices: intention, measure, patience.

note: Gates of Send and Return, SENDER/RECEIVER named pairs; same covenant paragraph R7-R10; deceit dims bridge.

phrase: return what you would borrow in your darkest hour; Gate of Balance counting intention, measure, timing/patience
note: Nano agents share darkest-hour maxim (Agent_3 R4 'own worst hour' variant first), Gate of Balance/Clarity, Mapper; Gemini pair share full-five/half.
